clips.title: The story
paras: In Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers Horde travelers Agamaggan's Strength in return for Blood Shards. The captive Razormane shaman draws on his people's reverence for the ancient boar demigod and his hatred of the rival Bristleback tribe.

The quilboar honor Agamaggan, an ancient boar demigod whose spilled blood is said to have formed the red Blood Shards scattered across the Barrens. They treat the crystals as sacred, drawing on their power to strengthen their front-line fighters. Mangletooth, an elder Razormane shaman held captive in Camp Taurajo, offers this strength to Horde champions. He claims your foes will cower as they do before the Razormane's mightiest champions.

Mangletooth offers his strength out of spite. The orcs and tauren captured and caged the old quilboar, whose Razormane tribe is at war with the rival Bristleback. Unable to break his chains and slaughter them himself, he trades Agamaggan's gifts for help against them. He rewards those who destroy Bristleback tribes and take the sacred Blood Shards from their lands.

paras: I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, traveler.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him!
I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you.
